_comment: Configuration templates only. Before import, replace every host:pi-adsb with the actual Agent host and device:/dev/root with the actual device; dashboard variables do not apply to monitors. Create each JSON object separately after removing _comment. The array is not a single monitor payload. No monitors are deployed by this file.
name: ADS-B Receiver Offline
message:
**ADS-B receiver is offline** — average received rate below 0.5 messages/sec over 5 minutes.

Check:
1. dump1090: `systemctl status dump1090-fa or dump1090-mutability`
2. adsbdawg: `systemctl status adsbdawg`
3. RTL-SDR dongle connected?
4. Pi reachable?

@pagerduty-adsb

name: ADS-B Hijack Squawk 7500 Detected
message:
**HIJACK SQUAWK 7500 DETECTED** in your ADS-B coverage area.

Aircraft squawking 7500 indicates an unlawful interference / hijack situation.

Monitor closely and cross-reference with flight tracking services.

@notify-channel

This counts received SBS frames, not unique incidents or current aircraft state. Repeated frames count repeatedly; missing telemetry cannot establish an all-clear.

name: ADS-B General Emergency Squawk 7700 Detected
message:
**EMERGENCY SQUAWK 7700** detected in ADS-B coverage area.

Aircraft declaring a general emergency. @notify-channel

This counts received SBS frames, not unique incidents or current aircraft state. Repeated frames count repeatedly; missing telemetry cannot establish an all-clear.

name: ADS-B Radio Failure Squawk 7600 Detected
message:
**RADIO FAILURE SQUAWK 7600** detected. Aircraft has lost radio communication. @notify-channel

This counts received SBS frames, not unique incidents or current aircraft state. Repeated frames count repeatedly; missing telemetry cannot establish an all-clear.

name: ADS-B Emergency Flag Active
message: **Aircraft emergency flag** set in ADS-B transponder data. @notify-channel

name: ADS-B Message Rate Anomaly
message:
**Degraded ADS-B reception** — message rate below 2 msg/sec for 15 minutes.

Possible causes: interference, antenna issue, atmospheric conditions, RTL-SDR thermal throttle.

Check Pi CPU temperature: `vcgencmd measure_temp`

name: Raspberry Pi CPU Temperature High
message:
**Pi CPU temperature {{value}}°C** is approaching the throttle limit (80°C).

At 80°C dump1090 will throttle and ADS-B reception will degrade.

Check: ventilation, case cooling, ambient temperature.

name: Raspberry Pi Disk Space Critical
message:
**Pi disk used fraction: {{value}} (0.95 = 95%).** Logs or data may fill the SD card, causing service outage.

`df -h / && journalctl --disk-usage`

name: ADS-B Processing Lag High
message:
**Message processing lag {{value}}ms** — Pi may be under CPU pressure or dump1090 is buffering.

Check: `top`, `systemctl status adsbdawg; check the installed dump1090 variant`
